javax.swing

接口 ListModel<E>

  • 类型参数:
    E - the type of the elements of this model
    所有已知子接口:
    ComboBoxModel<E>, MutableComboBoxModel<E>
    所有已知实现类:
    AbstractListModel, BasicDirectoryModel, DefaultComboBoxModel, DefaultListModel, MetalFileChooserUI.DirectoryComboBoxModel, MetalFileChooserUI.FilterComboBoxModel, MonitorListModel, MotifFileChooserUI.FilterComboBoxModel, MotifFileChooserUI.MotifDirectoryListModel, MotifFileChooserUI.MotifFileListModel, SourceModel, SynthFileChooserUIImpl.DirectoryComboBoxModel, SynthFileChooserUIImpl.FilterComboBoxModel, WindowsFileChooserUI.DirectoryComboBoxModel, WindowsFileChooserUI.FilterComboBoxModel

    public interface ListModel<E>
    This interface defines the methods components like JList use to get the value of each cell in a list and the length of the list. Logically the model is a vector, indices vary from 0 to ListDataModel.getSize() - 1. Any change to the contents or length of the data model must be reported to all of the ListDataListeners.
    作者:
    Hans Muller
    另请参阅:
    JList
